chunks: Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Abu Abdillah from his father from his forefathers, peace be upon them, said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent me to Yemen and said: O Ali, do not fight anyone until you invite them (to Islam), and by Allah's oath, for Allah to guide a man through your hand is better for you than what the sun has risen upon and set, and for you is his allegiance, O Ali.'
ai.seo_question: What were the specific instructions given to Imam Ali when sent to Yemen regarding warfare and invitation to Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith highlights the strategic principle of *ad-du'ah ila al-Islam* (invitation before confrontation) during Ali’s mission to Yemen, reflecting the Shia emphasis on patience and wisdom in da'wah. The Prophet’s promise of *wilayah* (spiritual authority and allegiance) over the guided individual underscores the transformative power of sincere guidance, linking it to the spiritual hierarchy established by the Ahl al-Bayt.
